messages:
Marta (PM): Quick check: we need a final compact GA gate for the predictor pipeline. Tiny checklist: SLA wording, runbook + rollback, oncall coverage for week-1, alert thresholds, billing codes for promo. Who volunteers to close each item?

Eli (SRE): SLA suggestion: 99.9% monthly uptime; p95 <= 120ms; p99 <= 400ms. Operational rule: if queue_time >200ms for 2m or error_rate >1% for 5m -> trigger fallback routing to small-model and page oncall. I can own SRE readiness and fallback config.

Jess (Docs): I'll finish the runbook (escalation steps + rollback command) and publish the runbook link. ETA: tomorrow AM. Need final confirmation on the exact rollback CLI from SRE.

Sanjay (Sales): Sales wants a launch promo: 10% for 60 days to up to 20 named accounts; finance OK if spend capped. I'll own promo list + billing codes. Need product + finance signoff.

Dana (Product Ops): Monitoring minimums: prompt-regression alert (by prompt-set), token_cost_per_request metric, model_error_rate per version, and a daily canary smoke. Define alert severities: P0 page, P1 notify. Ops-bot can run nightly smoke.

Ops-bot: Nightly smoke scheduled 04:00 UTC against canary; failures will post to #eng-sre and the rollout dashboard.

Carla (Legal): For any SLA carve-outs (eg Customer X HIPAA), we require a signed addendum/DPA; legal will draft template. No binding exceptions without signed docs.

Marta (PM): Great. Owners: SRE -> Eli; Docs -> Jess; Sales/promo -> Sanjay; Monitoring -> Dana; Legal -> Carla. I'll collate into a single checklist and declare "Ready to Ship" once all owners confirm green. Add any last items below. :rocket:
